name: refresh
description: Refresh now: re-run dt against Delta (shop/world) for Sergey's open PRs — authored by him, plus River-authored PRs assigned to him — (checks, merge readiness, reviews, mergeability and Merge Garden comments per PR) and PRs requesting his review, persist the result, and return group counts. Takes ~10-40 s. Throws with the failure message if the refresh fails (previous data is kept).

name: list_prs
description: List tracked PRs from the last refresh (does not call Delta). With `group`, returns that group's rows; without it, returns every group. Sergey's own PRs (authored, or River-authored and assigned to him; ownership author|assigned): merging (Merge Garden accepted /merge and the PR is in flight: waiting for CI or in the merge queue), ready_to_merge (human-approved, nothing blocking), blocked (human-approved but blocked by a conflict or a required check/status), binks_comments, ci_failing, waiting_on_review (no counting human approval, or a newer human change request), draft. waiting_on_my_review: PRs requesting his review. Each row has number, title, url, status, author, ownership, updatedAt (last update on Delta).

name: summary
description: One-line summary of Sergey's Delta PRs from the last pull: counts per group, data age in minutes, last error, and the 5 most recent refresh runs (source schedule/view/agent, ok, duration).

name: get_pr
description: Full tracked detail for one PR number from the last refresh: group, status, review verdict (approved/changes_requested/needs_approval/unknown), counting human approvers (approvedBy), ignored approvals with reasons (bot, dismissed, not counted by Delta), plain-words blockers (blockedBy), Merge Garden state (merge: merging/stopped/requested/cancelled with phase or reason), ownership (author/assigned) and authorBrand, Binks state/findings, failing checks, CI, raw merge blockers.

name: open_pr
description: Open https://delta.shopify.io/shop/world/pull/<number> in the default browser on Sergey's Mac (used by the widget's row links, since the widget sandbox blocks pop-ups).
